businesses.business: Public health products and biopharma services

offering_description.value: The company supplies opioid overdose nasal sprays to consumers, community organizations and public agencies. It develops, manufactures and supplies medical countermeasures for government and public health preparedness. Its in-house teams provide development and manufacturing services to biopharma companies, governments and nonprofits.

quotes.quote: We specialize in developing, manufacturing, and supplying medical countermeasures for national security and public health preparedness.
